scenes.narration: Nothing in Beyond the Boundary was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Beyond the Boundary
(Japanese: 境界の彼方, Hepburn: Kyōkai no Kanata) is a Japanese light novel series written by Nagomu Torii, with illustrations
by Tomoyo Kamoi. The work won an honorable mention in the Kyoto Animation Award competition in 2011. The
psychology underneath Beyond the Boundary is simpler and older than the story on top. Set in Kashihara, Nara,
this story follows a young boy named Akihito Kanbara who is an immortal being and half a spirit.
After Akihito saves a girl named Mirai Kuriyama from committing suicide, he learns that she is a spirit
world warrior and their lives become intertwined.
